faq.question: What courses does Success Academy offer?
faq.answer: We offer comprehensive coaching for UPSC CSE, SSC (CGL/CHSL/MTS/GD), Banking (IBPS/SBI/RBI), Railways (RRB NTPC/Group D), State PSC, Defence (NDA/CDS), Teaching Exams (CTET/UPTET), and Police Recruitment exams.

faq.question: Do you offer both online and offline classes?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer both online live classes and offline classroom programs at our centers. Online students get access to live interactive sessions, recorded lectures, and PDF notes. Offline students benefit from face-to-face interaction and our digital classrooms.

faq.question: How does the Daily & Weekly Test Series work?
faq.answer: Daily tests (25-50 questions) are conducted Monday through Saturday covering specific subjects. Sunday is a full-length mock test (100 questions). All tests come with instant results, detailed solutions, and All India Ranking.

faq.question: What is the fee structure for various courses?
faq.answer: Fees vary by course: UPSC CSE (Rs. 85,000/year), SSC CGL (Rs. 35,000/8 months), Bank PO (Rs. 28,000/6 months), Railways (Rs. 22,000/6 months), Teaching Exams (Rs. 25,000/6 months). We also offer EMI options and scholarships for meritorious students.

faq.question: Do you provide study material?
faq.answer: Yes, all enrolled students receive comprehensive study materials including subject-wise notes, practice workbooks, current affairs compilations, previous year question papers, and monthly current affairs PDFs.

faq.question: Is there a demo class available before enrollment?
faq.answer: Absolutely! We offer 3 free demo classes so you can experience our teaching methodology firsthand. Fill out the contact form or call us to schedule your demo sessions.

faq.question: What is the batch timing for classes?
faq.answer: We run multiple batches: Morning (7:00 AM - 9:30 AM), Afternoon (2:00 PM - 4:30 PM), and Evening (5:30 PM - 8:00 PM). Weekend batches are also available for working professionals.

faq.question: Do you help with exam form filling and guidance?
faq.answer: Yes, we provide complete guidance on exam notifications, application form filling, admit card download, and result checking. Our counselors keep students updated on all important dates.
